s15_0.text: The cat sat on the bus.

s16_0.text: He can hop on the bus.

s16_1.text: The pot has a cup on top.

s17_0.text: The bug got on the hat.

s18_1.text: The dog sat on the sand.

s18_2.text: Dad and the dog stand up.

s19_0.text: The dog is in the sand.

s19_1.text: His cat hid in the bin.

s22_1.text: The man is in the mud.

s22_2.text: Tim must not miss the bus.

s23_0.text: Ten red hens sit in a den.

s23_1.text: Ben the dog spots the hens.

s23_3.text: Ben gets a rest on his bed.

s24_2.text: The jam is in his pocket.

s25_1.text: Mom and Dad jump in the sand.

s26_1.text: A flock of ducks is on the land.

s26_2.text: The clock is on the block.

s27_0.text: Six fox cubs sit in a box.

s27_1.text: Max the fox is next to the box.

s29_1.text: A squid is in the pond.

s31_0.text: We will visit the vet in the van.

s31_2.text: Wet or vet? West or vest?

s32_0.text: The bug can buzz and zigzag.
